childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_image_alt: Nne ma obu nna ji nwa amuru ohuru ma na-ele ya anya
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Mgbe a mụrụ ụmụ ọhụrụ, ọhụhụ ha adịghị ike. N'ụzọ bụ isi, ha dị ka ndị 'ìsì'. Otú ọ dị, ọhụhụ ha ga-etolite n’ime afọ 5 ruo 8 sochirinụ, ebe mmezi kasịnụ na-eme n’ime ọnwa 18 mbụ nke ndụ. Nke a bụ oge dị oke mkpa.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: N’oge a, usoro ịhụ ihe nke anya na ụbụrụ ga-adị mma ma nata mkpali. Nke a bụ oge kacha mma iji chọpụta ọrịa ma zipu maka ọgwụgwọ.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_brain_image_alt: Anya na ụzọ ọhụhụ ndị na-ejikọta ha na ụbụrụ
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_titl: Ihe kpatara na otú anyị si achọpụta ọrịa iji kwalite mmepe ọhụhụ nke ọma
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Ọrịa ọ bụla nke anya ma ọ bụ ụbụrụ ga-eme ka mmepe daa nwayọ ma gbochie ọhụhụ ogologo oge. Nke a bụ ya mere o ji dị mkpa ịchọpụta ngwa ngwa o kwere mee ihe ọ bụla a pụrụ ịgwọ nke na-emetụta mmepe ọhụhụ na mmepe zuru ezu nkịtị.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_question_bubble: A pụrụ ime nke a site n’ịjụ ajụjụ gbasara ọhụhụ, ime ime, ọmụmụ, ọrịa ọ bụla na mmepe zuru ezu
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_observe_copy: Mgbe ahụ lelee anya iji nyochaa mmepe ọhụhụ, wee nyochaa ọrịa anya site n’ime ule fundal 'red' reflex na ilele akụkụ ihu nke anya
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_paragr: N'ime akpa nwa, nwa e bu n'afọ nwere ụda dị nro na nke dị jụụ gbara ya gburugburu, gụnyere obi nne ya na olu na ụda sitere n'ụwa.
Ka afọ ime na-eru n'ọkwa ikpeazụ ya, anya nwa ọhụrụ nwere ike imeghe n'ime akpa nwa.
Ọ bụ ezie na ha enwebeghị ike ịhụ ihe oyiyi ma ọ bụ nkọwa, ha nwere ike ịhụ mgbanwe n'ìhè.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_image_: Ihe atụ nke afọ ime nke nwa e bu n'afọ n'afọ
Ihe atụ ime afọ ime n'oge na-egosi mmata nke ìhè
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_paragr: N'oge a mụrụ ọhụụ dị nnọọ ka nke okenye. Nwa amụrụ ọhụrụ 'kpuru ìsì' na-adịghị ahụ anya nke ruru 6/600. Ha anaghị aghọta ọtụtụ agba ma nwee mmetụta dị iche iche dị ala. Ha enweghị stereovision na anya ha nwere ike squiring ugbu a ugboro ugboro.
Otú ọ dị, ha ga-ele anya ozugbo na ihu na nso nso, ma mechie anya ha ka ọ bụrụ ọkụ na-egbuke egbuke. Ọhụụ ha site ugbu a ga-etolite ngwa ngwa wee dị ka okenye site na afọ 8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_image_: Ọhụụ amụrụ ọhụrụ na ihe atụ ọmụmụ
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_paragr: N'ime izu abụọ ọhụhụ abawanyela nke ukwuu. Ha nwere ike ịhụ nkọwa ụfọdụ, ọkachasị ma ọ bụrụ na ihe dị nso. Enweghị agba na ihe ha na-ahụ bụ ewepụghị, n'ihi na anya ha na-adịghị ma mgbe niile na-arụ ọrụ ọnụ maka omimi nghọta.
Mgbe ụfọdụ, anya ha ga-abata ma ọ bụ pụta nwa oge. A na-akpọ nke a squinting. Nke a kwesịrị ịkwụsị ime n'ọnwa atọ.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_image_: Ihe atụ mmepe ọhụụ izu abụọ
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_paragr: N'ime otu ọnwa, ọhụụ agba na-amalite ịmalite. Ha ga-enwe mmasị karịa anya karịsịa ihu. Ha ga-amalitekwa ịgbalị iso ihe na-akpụ akpụ.
Ha ga-amatawanye ụda ndị a ma ama gụnyere olu ndị ama ama dịka ezinụlọ ha. Ma malite iji ihe ha na-ahụ na-ejikọta ihe ha nụrụ.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_image_: Mmepe anya n'etiti izu abụọ na otu ọnwa
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_paragr: N'ime ọnwa atọ, anya ha kwesịrị ịdị ogologo ma na-arụkọ ọrụ ọnụ iji mepụta ọhụụ 3D. Nghọta omimi ọhụrụ a na-enyere ha aka iru ihe n'ụzọ ziri ezi. Ha ga-enwe ike ịgbaso ihe na-agba ọsọ ngwa ngwa mana ọ na-esiri ike ịgbanwe nhazi site n'otu ihu ma ọ bụ ihe gaa na nke ọzọ ngwa ngwa.
Ha na-enwe mmasị ile anya naanị otu ihe n'otu oge. Ha nwekwara ike ịmalite ịkpọ ụda mbụ ha bara uru.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_image_: Mmepe anya n'etiti otu ọnwa na atọ
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_6_paragr: Nwa ọhụrụ nwere ọhụụ na-etolite etolite ga-enwe obi ụtọ ịhụ iko ma ọ bụ ngaji na-aṅụ ihe ọṅụṅụ ma nwee ike na-edozi ma na-agbaso ihu n'ebe dị anya nke 1-2 mita yana nwee ike ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ihu ndị ama ama na nke ọ na-amaghị site na ma ihu na olu.
Ha nwekwara ike ịmalite ịhụ ihe ndị ọzọ dị anya. N'ịbụ ndị ọchịchọ ịmata ihe kpaliri, ha ga-amalite iru ihe.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_7_paragr: N'ime ọnwa 6 ruo 12 nke afọ ọhụụ na-akawanye mma yana gburugburu 6/36. Ebe a na-ele anya ma mara ihu agbatịla mita abụọ. Ihe niile dị n'ọhụụ na-akawanye mma site na iru na njide ziri ezi karị.

N'oge a, ha na-enwekwu mmasị na ihe oyiyi na akwụkwọ na na telivishọn, ọ bụ ezie na ihe ndị dị adị na-agba ume ka ha na-agbaba na gburugburu ụbọchị ọmụmụ mbụ ha, na-aga n'ihu ihe ndị na-amasị mmasị. Ikwu okwu ha na-etolite, ụda ga-abụkwa okwu mbụ n'oge a.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_paragr: N'ime ọnwa 18, ọhụhụ na-eto nke ọma dịka ọ bụ ezie na ọ ka na-amachaghị nke ọma na nhụsianya nke gburugburu 6/18. Ha ga-enwekwa ike ịmata aha ha ugbu a ma na-eji ọtụtụ okwu eme ihe.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_image_: Mmepe anya n'etiti ọnwa iri na abụọ na iri na asatọ
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_paragr: Mgbe ọnwa 18 gachara, ọhụụ ka chọrọ ọtụtụ afọ iji tozuo oke. A ga-etolite nhụhụhụ nke okenye nkịtị site na afọ 8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_image_: Mmepe anya n'etiti ọnwa iri na asatọ na afọ asatọ
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_parag: Mgbe afọ 8 gasịrị, usoro a na-ahụ anya nwere ike ọ gaghị eme nke ọma na ọgwụgwọ dịka ịwa ahụ cataract. Ya mere, a na-eme nchọpụta ọrịa na ntugharị maka ọgwụgwọ dị ka o kwere mee.

Enwere ike ịhụ na nnukwu mmepe na-apụta n'etiti ọmụmụ na ọnwa 18 ma na-aga n'ihu nke nta nke nta n'oge nwata. N'ime oge a, ọ dị mkpa ka nwatakịrị ahụ dị mma site na usoro ọhụụ na-enweghị ọrịa ma nye ya gburugburu ebe obibi na-akpali akpali na mmụta mmụta.
Nchọpụta mmalite nke ọrịa site na ntinye aka maka ọgwụgwọ dị mkpa iji nyere aka mee ka mmepe anya ma n'ozuzu ya dịkwuo elu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_image: Mgbe afọ asatọ gachara ihe atụ mmepe anya

i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_account_security:
Ọ bụrụ na ịmepụta akaụntụ, biko debe nkọwa nbanye gị na nchekwa.
Ị na-ahụ maka ọrụ na akaụntụ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị mee ka anyị mara maka iji n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi ma ọ bụ nsogbu nchekwa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_education_only: Ngwa a bụ ngwa mmụta iji kwado mmụta na ngbanwe. Ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ agụmakwụkwọ, iwu ma ọ bụ ọkachamara na enweghị ike ikwe nkwa ngafe ule, akara ule ma ọ bụ nsonaazụ ọ bụla. Nhọrọ ọmụmụ na mkpebi ka bụ ọrụ onye ọrụ.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_how_we_use_data:
Data a na-enyere aka ịhazi ngwa ahụ dabere na ebumnuche onye ọ bụla, ghọta ka esi eji ngwa ahụ wee kwalite atụmatụ ka oge na-aga. Enwere ike iji ya nweta kọntaktị maka mgbanwe dị mkpa na ngwa ma ọ bụ akaụntụ.
data nkeonwe anaghị ere.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_identity_check: Enwere ike ekwenye na njirimara tupu emechaa arịrịọ. Ọ bụrụ na a ga-edobe ozi ọ bụla maka ihe gbasara iwu ma ọ bụ nchekwa, a ga-akọwa nke a.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_minimum_data: Naanị ozi achọrọ iji rụọ ọrụ ma melite ọrụ ka a na-anakọta.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_service_limits: Ebumnuche bụ idobe ngwa ahụ na-enye aka yana ntụkwasị obi, mana ọ nweghị ọrụ zuru oke. Enweta ma ọ bụ nnwere onwe zuru oke na njehie enweghị ike ikwe nkwa, ngwa ahụ nwere ike ọ gaghị adabara ọnọdụ ọ bụla.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_storage: A na-echekwa ozi na sava na nchekwa data nke okporo ụzọ ụgbọ oloko wetara. Ụgbọ okporo ígwè na-enye nnabata na akụrụngwa; anyị na-ejikwa otu esi eji data n'ime ngwa ma debe ya naanị ogologo oge ọ bụla achọrọ ya.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_third_party: Anyị na-adabere na ọrụ ndị ọzọ tụkwasịrị obi, dị ka ndị na-eweta nnabata, iji mee ngwa ahụ. Ọrụ ndị a na-ahazi data dị ka achọrọ iji nye akụrụngwa ma enweghị ikike iji ya maka ebumnuche nke ha.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_uk_law_limits: Ruo n'iwu UK nyere ikike, ọ bụghị anyị na-ahụ maka mfu dị ka akara efu, ego efu ma ọ bụ ohere na-ebilite site na iji, ma ọ bụ enweghị ike iji, ngwa ahụ. Ọ nweghị ihe ebe a na-ewepụ ikike ọ bụla iwu UK nyere.

questions.prompt: Mgbe anyị na-enyocha maka RAPD, akụkụ nke ụzọ ọhụụ anyị na-enyocha bụ ndị bụ ndị?
options: Ọtọlịkpital lobe (etiti nke ọhụụ) nke ụbụrụ
Ụzọ ọhụụ site na etiti ụbụrụ ruo otu ọtọlịkpital lobe
Lens, retina na ụkwụ anya optic
questions.explanation: Retina na ụkwụ anya optic na-eme akụkụ nke mbụ nke usoro nnata, na-eweta ozi site n’anya ruo etiti ụbụrụ iji malite mmeghachi omume nke anya ma mee ka nha anya gbanwee.

questions.prompt: Kedu ihe nwere ike ịkpata RAPD?
questions.explanation: Ọgwụ ọrịa ọ bụla nke retina ma ọ bụ ụbụrụ anya na-emetụta ọrụ nkwenye ya nwere ike iduga RAPD, gụnyere ihe omume vascular na-emetụta retina.

questions.prompt: Kedu nke ndị a bụ ebumnuche isi nke ule nzaghachi 'red' fundal na nwata mụrụ ọhụrụ?
questions.explanation: Na nwata mụrụ ọhụrụ, ebumnuche isi bụ ịmata ọrịa na-egbochi ìhè ịbanye na anya. Nke a nwere ike ịgụnye ọrịa nke cornea, linzi, vitreous, retina ma ọ bụ ụbụrụ anya.

questions.prompt: Nwatakịrị ọnwa 3 nwere ngosi ọkụ 'ọbara uhie' na anya ekpe mana ngosi ahụ dị ntakịrị na anya aka nri. Kedu ihe kacha kwesịrị ime?
options: Gbochie ndị nne na nna obi
Hazie ntinye kpọrọ ihe ngwa ngwa na ọkachamara anya
Hazie ntinye nkịtị na ọkachamara anya
questions.explanation: Ihe ọ bụla na-ezighị ezi na ule a chọrọ nyocha ngwa ngwa site na ọkachamara anya n’ihi na ọrịa dị ize ndụ, dị ka cataract ma ọ bụ retinoblastoma, nwere ike ịdị.

questions.prompt: Nwatakịrị ọnwa 9 a mụrụ mgbe izu 36 bịara na mmepe anya na-adịghị mma na enweghị ngosi ọkụ na anya abụọ. Kedu ihe kacha kwesị ntụ anya nke ihe ndị a?
questions.explanation: Ntufu nke mmeghachi omume fundal bụ n'ihi ihe na-egbochi ìhè ịbanye n'anya. Nchegbu anya nke ụmụaka a mụrụ tupu oge eruo nwere ike ime ka retina kewaa, ma ọ dịkarịsịrị n’ụmụaka a mụrụ tupu izu 34. Retinoblastoma nwere ike ime ka mmeghachi omume tufuo ma o nweghịkarị, na-eme na ihe dịka otu n'ime ụmụaka 15,000 mụrụ. Cataract bụ ihe kacha eme na ụmụaka na ụmụntakịrị, na-eme na ihe dịka otu n'ime ndị mụrụ 1,000 ruo 2,000.

questions.prompt: Kedu n’ime ọnọdụ ndị a nọ n’aka ndị okenye bụ nke kacha adịghị ekwe omume ime ka mmeghachi omume fundal 'red' bụrụ abnormali?
questions.explanation: Stroke nke lobe occipital abụghịkarị ihe kpatara mmeghachi omume fundal bụrụ abnormali. N'agbanyeghị na ọ na-eme ka ahụhụ anya pụọ, nke a bụ n'ihi mmebi ụbụrụ karịa ọrịa metụtara ịdị ọcha nke otu akụkụ anya.

questions.prompt: Kedu usoro na n’usoro nke ihe ọkụ na-apụga iji mee ka fundus gbaa ọkụ ma mee ka fundal 'red' reflex pụta?
questions.explanation: Ìhè na-apụ n’ọnụ ụzọ kornea, linzi na vitreous iji ruo retina, nke bụ akwa doro anya nke dị n’elu choroid nke fundus nke ìhè si na ya laghachitere. Ọrịa nke kornea, linzi, vitreous, retina ma ọ bụ choroid nwere ike ime ka ule ìhè uhie na-alọghachi site n'ime anya ghara ịdị mma.
